title: I Still Dream of Taking First!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Satsuki Sho behind us, we'll be training even harder than ever in preparation for the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Phew! Ah…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Man, this is tough!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: My form really fell apart in the second half. I guess I still don't have enough stamina.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Can we do more training to increase my stamina? I need to do even more running on my own too…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She takes out her notebook, and I see how crammed her personal training routine is.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah! No, no, hehe. I mean this is what everyone's notebook looks like. It just means I need to work even harder.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby is a once-in-a-lifetime race. I need to be the absolute best I can be!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, as we're training, many reporters gather nearby to interview Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Bourbon's been getting interviewed a lot lately. With how good she's getting, I guess that shouldn't be surprising.

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Reporter
text_block_list.text: I have to get something good out of Bourbon today no matter what…

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Reporter
text_block_list.text: …I really hope I can write a good article. But I'm sure this time will be a bust too… Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I wonder what's eating him… I guess being a reporter is hard too.

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Reporter
text_block_list.text: Oh really?! So there's an Umamusume you're watching out for in the Japanese Derby?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Affirmative. She's usually more of the quiet and modest type, but I caught a glimpse of her strength at the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I've watched her train since then as well, and I've confirmed that she's rapidly improving.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: In conclusion, I've deemed her a formidable opponent for the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Reporter
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you so much! Um… so, next, I'd like to ask—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! Who exactly is it you're talking about?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: No way! So Bourbon's had her eye on Rice Shower too?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's right. I interviewed Rice the other day!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yes. I ran into her while I was out on a walk…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, Rice! What a coincidence! I'm looking forward to running with you in the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: M-me too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wait a second. Is that a hole in the sole of your shoe? Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah! You're right! Maybe I ran too much. I should get new ones.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: You've been running so much your shoes are falling apart?! You must seriously be working hard!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Now that I think about it, when I raced you at the Satsuki Sho, I could tell how hard you've been working! You ran really well too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: D-do you think so? I still haven't caught up yet, though…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Caught up to… who? Oh, do you mean Bourbon?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: What?! How did you know?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Well, I actually saw you in the runners' tunnel at the Satsuki Sho…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-you saw that? Oh…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Sorry, I didn't mean to spy on you! But you were so passionate, it made me want to cheer you on!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I totally get why you look up to Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: The crowd just lights up when she runs! She's so cool!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sh-she really is!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: She's so strong and cool and she makes everyone smile when they see her. She really is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: That's why… someday… I want to be just like her…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I hope I can do it…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I feel like I got a really good scoop today!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: They're both amazing! Bourbon for being able to inspire everyone like that, and Rice for working so hard to improve herself because of Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Reporter
text_block_list.text: U-um, excuse me. Could I—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! Would you mind telling me a little more about that?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wh-what?! Oh, s-sure!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Who would've thought she felt that?! People are definitely going to want to read about this!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Oh, it might be a good idea to ask a specialist to predict which of them is going to win.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hm. Which of… them?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: But the brass said we don't have to bother with anyone else. It's Mihono Bourbon that everyone wants to read about…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They seem to be too caught up in their work to realize that the Umamusume right in front of them is also running in the Japanese Derby.
choice_data_list: (As her trainer, I can't just sit here quietly…)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hey, wait a minute!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I understand that the remarkable relationship between Bourbon and Rice might cast a shadow over the other runners!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: And I get that Bourbon is the one in demand right now…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But, you know, that doesn't mean one of the other racers can't win.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Oh! You're Matikanetannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I-I-I'm so sorry! I didn't realize!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: No, no, no! I totally get it! I mean, there's nothing special about me at all! I'm ordinary! I'm nobody!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But… But even so… I believe I have a chance of winning.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: After all, I'm the same as everyone else. If it's not first place, I don't need it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has the same gentle air about her as always, but there is unmistakable passion in her words.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few hours later, we spot the reporter with the round glasses looking moved.

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Reporter
text_block_list.text: …That's right. You don't have to be special…

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Reporter
text_block_list.text: You don't have to be special… You just have to want to win…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby is almost here.
